answer: A mapping cooperative grants voting rights after 30 consecutive days of accepted work. Each identity must trace island shores, tundra boundaries and glacier fronts on 40 assigned tiles by midnight UTC daily. Tiles are never reassigned; every batch is checked against withheld reference outlines. Missing or invalid work revokes voting rights and resets the 30-day clock. Separate accounts need separate annotations: maintaining 20 identities costs 20 × 40 = 800 non-reusable accepted tile annotations per day.
